test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held On: 30 June, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: If 30% of P = 0.25 of Q = (1)/(5) of S, then P : Q : S is ____________.
solution:
**Given:**

30% of P = 0.25 of Q = (1)/(5) of S

**Calculation:**

30% of P = 0.25 of Q = (1)/(5) of S = k

⇒ 3P/10 = Q/4 = S/5 = k

P = 10K/3 ; Q = 4k ; S = 5k

P : Q : S = 10K : 12k : 15k

P : Q : S = 10 : 12 : 15

**∴ The correct option is 2. **
